aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Snapdeal implementation — Join to OMS for TDS Rate Validation
filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where runtime supplies it.
formula_sql:
SELECT
  n.sub_order_no,
  n.gross_amount AS tds_amount,
  o.charged_amount AS order_value,
  ROUND(100.0 * ABS(n.gross_amount) / NULLIF(o.charged_amount, 0), 4) AS effective_tds_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_non_order n
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
  ON n.sub_order_no = o.suborder_code
  AND o.is_active = true
WHERE n.is_active = true
  AND n.transaction_type IN ('COD TDS INV', 'NCOD TDS INV');
